t: Appendix E. For the system administrator
x: href="#app-sysadmin" aria-label="Link to this section"> This appendix is for the person who installs and looks after the program. It needs access to the server, the database and the program folder.

href="#s-requirements" aria-label="Link to this section"> Component Requirement PHP 8.1 or newer (8.2 or newer recommended), with the pdo_mysql and mbstring extensions Database MySQL 5.5.3 or newer, or MariaDB 5.5 or newer Web server Apache (the .htaccess files are included) or nginx Browser Any current browser Internet Only to load Bootstrap from a CDN; see Offline use PHP and MySQL versions are separate: old XAMPP packages with MySQL 5.5 come with PHP 5, which cannot run this program. Install a current XAMPP, or point a PHP 8 installation at your MySQL 5.5 server.

href="#s-installing" aria-label="Link to this section"> With XAMPP and phpMyAdmin: Unzip the folder into C:\xampp\htdocs\ , so that you have C:\xampp\htdocs\accounting-system\index.php . Start Apache and MySQL in the XAMPP Control Panel. Open phpMyAdmin at http://localhost/phpmyadmin and choose Import . Choose database/accounting_system_clean.sql to start real bookkeeping (the setup, a few sample names and no transactions), or database/accounting_system.sql for the demo company with about two and a half months of transactions. Click Go . Either file creates the database accounting_system . If your MySQL user has a password, or you used another database name, edit config/config.php . Open http://localhost/accounting-system/ and log in as admin with the password Admin@12345. You must choose a new password straight away. From the command line, php tools/install.php does the same (see Command-line tools).

href="#s-configuration-configconfigphp" aria-label="Link to this section"> Setting What it holds db: host, port, name, user, pass, charset The database connection (utf8mb4) app: name The program name shown on screen; left as "Accounting System" (or "G-SMaRT Integrated Cooperative System"), the program shows G-SMaRT Integrated Cooperative System app: timezone The company time zone, Asia/Manila by default app: currency The currency sign, ₱ app: debug Detailed error pages, switched on only by the environment variable APP_DEBUG=1 app: upload_dir Where uploaded receipts are kept (storage/receipts) master: name (optional) Another name for the platform database when several companies are set up The environment variables DB_HOST , DB_PORT , DB_NAME and DB_USER override the values in the file. In the file as delivered, the password is read from the file itself. Important config/config.php holds the database user and password. Never send it to anyone, never attach it to a support e-mail or a screenshot, and never place a copy where the web server can serve it. The .htaccess files (or the nginx rules) stop browsers from opening the config, app, database, modules, storage, tools and views folders; keep them in place. Settings that users change inside the program (company details, password rules, lockout, session timeout, finance charges, negative stock, the closing date) are in Company, Security & Closing Date , not in this file.

href="#s-upgrading-to-a-new-version" aria-label="Link to this section"> Make a backup of the database ( Backup & Restore , phpMyAdmin Export, or tools/export_sql.php ), and a copy of the program folder including storage/ and config/config.php . Copy the new program files over the old ones. Keep your config/config.php . In phpMyAdmin (Import) or Navicat (Execute SQL File), select your company database and run the files in database/migrations/ that you have not run yet, oldest first. Log in. If a file is still missing, the program stops after log-in with the page Database update needed , which names the files still to run, in order. The upgrade files, in order: 2026_09_19_classes_cash_voucher.sql , 2026_09_21_asset_maintenance_debit_memo_logo.sql , 2026_09_22_memorized_budgets_imports.sql , 2026_09_23_item_search_per_transaction.sql , 2026_09_24_subsidiary_ledger.sql , 2026_09_25_bluetooth_receipt_printer.sql , 2026_09_26_pos_default_site_class.sql , 2026_09_27_find_report_design.sql , 2026_09_28_multi_company.sql and 2026_09_29_reconcile_saved_charges.sql . A database older than the Disassemble / Process Items feature also needs 2026_09_17_item_processing.sql first ( 2026_09_17_item_processing_sample_data.sql is optional sample data). Every file is written for MySQL 5.5, keeps all existing data, and is safe to run a second time. Important Never import database/accounting_system.sql or database/accounting_system_clean.sql over a database that is in use. Both drop and recreate every table: all your records would be replaced by the sample data. Upgrade only with the files in database/migrations/ . With several companies, every company database needs the update. The Super Admin runs them with Companies > Database updates on the platform pages, or you run php tools/platform.php update-all . After upgrading from a version with the older average costing, you may run Rebuild data once in Utilities: Verify & Rebuild Data to recost past sales. It is optional: new transactions use the current costing at once. Make a backup first, because the cost of past sales may change.

href="#s-command-line-tools" aria-label="Link to this section"> Run them from the program folder, for example php tools/install.php . They refuse to run from a browser. Command What it does php tools/install.php Creates the database (if missing), the tables, the audit trail protection triggers and the setup data. Stops if the database already has tables php tools/install.php --demo The same, plus sample transactions dated around the day you run it php tools/install.php --drop Drops and recreates the database first: deletes all data php tools/export_sql.php --out=backup-2026-09-30.sql Writes one complete, importable SQL file (tables, data and triggers) php tools/send_scheduled_reports.php E-mails the memorized reports that have a schedule; add --company=N for one company php tools/platform.php list Lists the companies, their status, database and Company Code php tools/platform.php reset-superadmin (username) (password) Gives a Super Admin a new password, unlocks the account and asks for a new password at log-in php tools/platform.php sync (company id) Rebuilds the platform's list of that company's usernames php tools/platform.php update-all Runs the pending upgrade files on every company database tools/seed.php (the chart of accounts, roles, users, lists and number series of a new installation), tools/demo_data.php (the sample transactions) and tools/lib.php are used by install.php and are not run on their own. export_sql.php without --out writes to database/accounting_system.sql and replaces the demo file delivered with the program: always give --out . Add --no-create-db to leave out the CREATE DATABASE and USE lines. It exports the database named in config/config.php (Company 1). platform.php works only after multi-company has been set up. Scheduled report e-mails send_scheduled_reports.php sends every memorized report that has a daily, weekly or monthly schedule and an e-mail address, as a CSV attachment. Each report runs with the access of the user who memorized it; a report that user can no longer open is skipped. It uses PHP's mail() , so configure SMTP in php.ini (XAMPP: sendmail.ini ). With several companies, one run sends the reports of every active company. Run it once a day: Linux (cron): 0 6 * * * php /path/to/accounting-system/tools/send_scheduled_reports.php Windows (Task Scheduler): create a daily task with the program C:\xampp\php\php.exe and the argument C:\xampp\htdocs\accounting-system\tools\send_scheduled_reports.php .

href="#s-storage-folders" aria-label="Link to this section"> Everything users upload and every backup made inside the program is kept under storage/ , which the web server must be able to write to and which browsers cannot open directly. Folder What it holds storage/backups Backups made on Backup & Restore (.sql or .sql.gz), the safety backups made before each restore (before_restore_...) and uploaded backup files (uploaded_...) storage/receipts Receipts uploaded in Receipt Management storage/receipts/inbox E-mailed receipts waiting to be imported storage/company The company logo storage/maintenance Pictures of parts attached to maintenance records storage/imports CSV files that passed Check the file on Import from CSV, kept for a day so they can be imported storage/platform multi_company.json, the switch that turns multi-company on storage/companies/c002, c003 ... The same folders for every company after the first With several companies, Company 1 keeps the folders above and each other company has its own folder, named after its number (c002 for company 2). Include the whole storage/ folder in your file backups. Note Moving storage/platform/multi_company.json away switches multi-company off in an emergency: the program then runs as Company 1 alone. Put the file back to return.

href="#s-backups" aria-label="Link to this section"> Inside the program: Backup & Restore writes the whole company database to one file in storage/backups , lists and downloads the backups, and restores one. A restore always makes a fresh backup of the current data first, and asks you to type RESTORE. From the command line: php tools/export_sql.php --out=FILE . phpMyAdmin: Export. With several companies, back up the platform database ( accounting_system_master , or the name set in the config) together with the company databases. Whichever way you use, keep a copy away from the server.

href="#s-offline-use" aria-label="Link to this section"> The pages load Bootstrap 5.3.3 and Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 from cdn.jsdelivr.net. To run without internet, download both and place these files, as listed in assets/vendor/README.txt : assets/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css assets/vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2 assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff The program uses the local copies automatically when they are there.

href="#s-web-server-notes" aria-label="Link to this section"> Apache: the included .htaccess files block the program's internal folders and .sql and .md files. nginx: deny the folders app, config, database, modules, storage, tools and views, hidden files, and .sql and .md files, and pass .php files to PHP-FPM. The README has a sample configuration. Printing receipts to a Bluetooth roll printer needs the page to be opened on an https:// address or on http://localhost/ .

href="#s-checklist-before-going-live" aria-label="Link to this section"> Import accounting_system_clean.sql , or run php tools/install.php without --demo . Change the admin password, and change or deactivate the demo users you do not need. Create a MySQL user just for this program (instead of root) and put it in config/config.php . Use HTTPS. The session cookie becomes secure automatically. Keep APP_DEBUG off. Enter the company details, password rules and session timeout in Company, Security & Closing Date . Check the Chart of Accounts and Module Default Accounts , the tax codes, terms, sites, POS terminals and payment methods. Review the roles, page access and special permissions (Appendix B), and give every user their own account. Enter the opening balances and opening stock, then set the closing date to the day before you start. Make a backup before each month-end close and keep a copy off the server. With several companies: keep the Super Admin's password safe (a second Super Admin is a good idea), check that each company has a Company Owner, and back up the platform database with the company databases.

href="#app-glossary" aria-label="Link to this section"> Term Meaning in the program Accumulated depreciation The depreciation recorded so far on a fixed asset, kept in the asset category's accumulated depreciation account Approve (right) The right to approve, on a page, the actions of other users that need supervisor approval Assembly (Inventory assembly) A stocked item made from other items listed as its components; you make it with Build Assemblies Audit trail The permanent record of every change, void, deletion, log-in, denied page, approval and permission change; entries cannot be edited or deleted Average cost The book value of an item divided by its quantity on hand over all sites; stock leaves at this cost Billable cost An expense or item line on a bill or check marked for a Customer:Job, offered on that customer's next invoice Bill of materials The components of an assembly and the quantity of each needed for one unit Build point The quantity of an assembly at or below which more should be built By-product A secondary output of a processing order, valued at a fixed value per unit that is taken out of the cost first; the co-products share the rest Cash drop Cash taken out of a POS drawer during a shift and recorded on Shifts, Cash Drops & Readings Cash voucher A payment of cash from a petty cash, revolving fund or other cash account, printed as a voucher Class A label of your own (branch, department, project) put on a transaction and on every ledger line it posts, so reports can be split by it Clearing account An account that holds card or e-wallet sales until the provider pays them into the bank Closing date The date through which the books are closed; transactions on or before it cannot be recorded or changed without special permission Co-product A main product of a processing order; co-products share the cost left after by-products and scrap Company Code With several companies, the code (such as ABD-7K2QX) an employee types to join a company; it is never a password Company Owner With several companies, the user who manages a company's employees, join requests and Company Code, with full authority in that company Credit limit The largest balance a customer may owe; an invoice above it needs the permission to exceed limits and a reason Creditable withholding tax The part of a payment a customer withholds for the BIR, entered in Receive Payments and debited to 1310 Customer:Job A customer with a job under it, shown as "ABC Trading Corp.:Office Renovation Project"; a job's balance counts in its customer's Delete Removing a transaction; its full copy stays in the audit trail Effective access What one user can really open and do, with the reason, shown on Effective Access (View as User) Employees & Other Names The list of people and bodies that are neither customers nor suppliers, used as payees and on subsidiary ledgers Find The search for transactions in every module at once, by any combination of filters Fiscal year The accounting year; the month it starts is set in Company, Security & Closing Date Forecast Expected sales per customer for a year, compared with actual sales in Forecast vs Actual by Customer Group item An item that stands for several items; on a form it is entered as those items Input tax VAT paid on purchases, debited to 1300 Input Tax Item receipt A record of goods received before the vendor's bill; it is later turned into a bill Job A project or sub-account of a customer (see Customer:Job) Layout A saved design of a report (columns, headings, fonts, footer, page); it can be shared and made the default Memorized report A report saved with its filters, which can be sent by e-mail on a schedule Memorized transaction A transaction saved as a model, entered again automatically or after a reminder on a schedule Module default accounts The accounts each module posts to when an item, tax code or form does not name one Negative stock A quantity on hand below zero, allowed only while the setting "Allow selling or moving stock below zero" is on, and listed on the Negative Inventory Listing Net book value The cost of a fixed asset less its accumulated depreciation Non-posting document An estimate, sales order or purchase order: it records a commitment and does not touch the ledger Opening Balance Equity The equity account (3900) that takes the other side of opening balances and opening stock Opening float The cash put in a POS drawer when a shift is opened Output tax VAT charged on sales, credited to 2100 Output Tax Page access Whether a role may open a page at all, set in Page Access Configuration Pending A saved invoice, sales receipt, build or processing order that does not post until it is marked final or completed Price level A named price list (such as Wholesale or VIP) given to a customer, as a percentage or as a price per item Processing order A transaction that turns input items into output items (disassembly, de-kitting, co-products) and shares the cost among the outputs Progress invoice An invoice for a percentage of an estimate Reconcile Matching an account's cleared items to the bank statement; cleared lines are protected afterwards Reorder point The quantity at or below which an item should be ordered again Role A set of page access, rights, special permissions and sites given to users Sales rep The person credited with a sale, used in the Sales by Rep reports Scrap Waste from a processing order, valued like a by-product at a fixed value per unit, often zero Segregation of duties Keeping apart duties that one person should not hold together; the program warns when roles combine them Shift A cashier's working period on a POS terminal, from opening float to Z-reading Site A place where stock is kept (warehouse, store, stockroom, van, damaged goods); quantities are kept per site Special permission A permission beyond page rights, such as viewing costs or a maximum discount, set per role Statement charge A charge added to a customer's account without an invoice, shown on the next statement Subsidiary ledger The entries of one name on the accounts marked With SL, shown by the Subsidiary Ledger report Super Admin With several companies, the platform administrator who manages every company and can open any of them Supervisor approval A second person's username and password, typed on the form, for an action above a user's limits Suspended sale A POS sale put aside to be recalled later; it posts nothing Tax code A VAT treatment on a line (VAT12, ZR zero-rated, EX VAT-exempt, NT non-taxable) with its rate and accounts Tender One way a POS customer pays (cash, card, e-wallet, voucher); a sale can have several Terminal A POS counter, with its site, cash account, receipt prefix and assigned users Terms The payment terms of a customer or vendor (such as Net 30 or 2% 10 Net 30), which set the due date and early-payment discount U/M set A set of units of measure for items, with a base unit in which stock and costs are kept (such as pc, dozen, box of 24) Unclassified A transaction or ledger line with no class Undeposited Funds The account (1050) that holds payments and sales receipts until Make Deposits moves them to the bank User override A page setting for one user that wins over all of that user's roles VAT-exclusive Prices and amounts on forms are before VAT; VAT is added on each line Void Cancelling a transaction while keeping it, marked VOID, with its effect on the ledger and stock removed With SL A mark on an account in the Chart of Accounts: every entry to it must name a customer, supplier, employee or other name X-reading A mid-shift summary of a POS terminal's sales and tenders; the register stays open Z-reading The closing reading of a POS shift, with the cash counted and the over or short; it is numbered per terminal
